purpose: Frozen target set for docs/plan-title-cleaning-fix.md. The backfill re-derives candidates from the predicate at execution time and DIFFS against this baseline (report additions/removals) before any write. predicate_bucket2: available=true AND hidden=false AND title IS NOT NULL AND array_length(regexp_split_to_array(btrim(title),'\s+'),1)=1 AND array_length(regexp_split_to_array(btrim(name),'\s+'),1)>=4
note: A meaningful share of bucket2 are legitimately sparse (source name is just BRAND - Garment, e.g. 'ACNE STUDIOS - Sweater' -> 'Sweater').
